hero.title: Electrical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A Master’s in Electrical Engineering is a postgraduate qualification for students interested in electrical power systems, electronics, renewable energy, smart grids, automation and electrical infrastructure. It can help engineering graduates develop specialised technical knowledge for careers in energy, utilities, manufacturing and technology. **Master’s in Electrical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** may be an option for graduates exploring related postgraduate specialisations in energy and smart electrical systems.

overview: Important course availability note: The University of Mauritius does not list a dedicated Master’s in Electrical Engineering in its published 2026–2027 postgraduate programme catalogue. However, it offers an MSc in Renewable Energy and Smart Electrical Systems, a two-year, part-time programme delivered fully online. This is a related specialisation, not the same qualification as a general Master’s in Electrical Engineering. Students researching **Study Electrical Engineering in Mauritius** should understand this distinction before applying.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Electrical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Electrical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Electrical Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
